instruction: Review the April 2026 incident log for SLA credit eligibility using the available sources. For each incident, determine whether a credit-eligible customer experienced an acknowledgement SLA breach. Calculate the total credit amount owed after applying per-customer monthly caps. Identify which customers are eligible to receive credits, which customers or incidents are excluded, and any system risk flags. Use only customer-facing incidents; exclude internal-only incidents, maintenance-window incidents, and customer-caused incidents. Return only a JSON object with these fields: total_credit_amount, credit_eligible_customers, excluded_customers, excluded_incidents, breach_incidents, risk_flags. total_credit_amount must be the total credit amount after applying monthly caps. credit_eligible_customers must be an array of short snake_case labels for Gold customers who receive credits this month. excluded_customers must be an array of short snake_case labels for customers who are affected but not eligible for automatic credit. excluded_incidents must be an array of short snake_case labels for incidents excluded from credit calculation. breach_incidents must be an array of short snake_case labels for incidents where a Gold customer SLA was breached. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case labels for reliability risks. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: INC-201 (P2): start 14:22, ack 14:37 = 15 min > 10 min SLA. Breaches for Apex (+300) and Meridian (+300). Harbor School bronze, no credit. INC-202 (P3): start 09:05, ack 09:19 = 14 min < 20 min P3 SLA => no breach. INC-203: in maintenance window (April 14 01:00-05:00), excluded. INC-204: customer-caused, excluded. INC-205 (P2): start 16:00, ack 16:18 = 18 min > 10 min SLA. Apex (+300) and Meridian (+300). Running totals before cap: Apex=600, Meridian=600. Monthly cap $500 per customer: Apex=min(600,500)=500, Meridian=min(600,500)=500. Total=1000. Breach incidents: INC-201 and INC-205. Risk: payment_api had 2 P2 breaches in April => repeat flag.
